question: Which of the following won the 2025 UNESCO/Guillermo Cano World Press Freedom Prize?
solution:
The correct answer is __**La Prensa.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Nicaragua’s La Prensa was awarded the 2025 UNESCO/Guillermo Cano World Press Freedom Prize.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **La Prensa, a century-old newspaper, has faced censorship, asset confiscations, and arrests under the Ortega-Murillo regime.**
 
• **Despite this repression, La Prensa remains committed to fearless journalism, earning recognition for its resilience.**
 
• **The UNESCO/Guillermo Cano World Press Freedom Prize honors La Prensa's dedication to press freedom.**
 
• La Prensa__
 __
 
• Founded - 1926
 
• Country - Nicaragua
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• UNESCO/Guillermo Cano World Press Freedom Prize__

 
 
• Established in 1997
 
• Named after Guillermo Cano, a Colombian journalist murdered for his work
 
• Awarded annually to individuals or organizations that have made significant contributions to press freedom
